quote: Summarization OpenIE addresses the problems of redundancy and fact fabrication in summarization.
Open Information Extraction (OpenIE) is the task of extracting relation tuples from plain text.
outputs: relation tuples consisting of subject(S), predicate(P), object(O), and any additional arguments(A)

quote: We report Precision (P), Recall (R), F1 Score (F1), and Area Under the Curve (AUC) for the OIE2016, WiRe57, and CaRB metrics.
